My teaching focuses on helping students develop strategic judgment: the ability to frame ambiguous problems, evaluate tradeoffs, reason through uncertainty, and make disciplined decisions.
:::

## Teaching Experience

::: {.paper-card}
### Essentials of Entrepreneurship  
**Instructor, Wharton Global Youth Program**

I teach entrepreneurship to high school students from around the world, with an emphasis on venture ideation, customer discovery, business models, experimentation, and strategic decision making.
:::

## Teaching Philosophy

I view strategy education as a form of critical-thinking training. My goal is not only to help students learn frameworks, but to help them practice the habits of effective strategists: asking sharper questions, identifying assumptions, comparing alternatives, anticipating consequences, and learning from feedback.

:::

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const carousel = document.querySelector(".student-carousel");
  if (!carousel) return;

  const track = carousel.querySelector(".student-comment-track");
  const slides = carousel.querySelectorAll(".student-comment-slide");
  const prev = carousel.querySelector(".student-comment-prev");
  const next = carousel.querySelector(".student-comment-next");

  let index = 0;

  function updateCarousel() {
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${index * 100}%)`;
  }

  prev.addEventListener("click", function () {
    index = index === 0 ? slides.length - 1 : index - 1;
    updateCarousel();
  });

  next.addEventListener("click", function () {
    index = index === slides.length - 1 ? 0 : index + 1;
    updateCarousel();
  });

  updateCarousel();
});
</script>
